name: DLSS5 NR for Forge
description: Forge-neo-only experimental, unofficial Neural Rendering for still images, with up to three independently configured passes before or after Hires. fix, presets and X/Y/Z comparisons. Requires Windows x64, Python 3.12 or 3.13, and a compatible NVIDIA GPU, driver and NR runtime. Other WebUI forks are not claimed compatible.
